name: Classy 20261124 (beta)
body:
This is a beta release. To get it on the player, choose Settings > General > System Update > Update Channel > Beta.

- With List Glide on, the arrow now moves with the highlight as one whole arrow, also on fast scrolls.
- All lists show the arrow only on the selected row. Settings rows no longer show a grey arrow on each row, and every Settings row that opens a page or a list of values now shows it when selected (Theme, Language, USB Drive and others had none before).
- The selected row of Artists, Genres and the song lists shows its arrow again.
- The top level of Settings shows the album cover on the right, as the main menu does.
- Settings > Menus > Music Menu Items can now reorder the Music menu, as Main Menu Items does for the main menu: hold a row, turn the wheel to move it, and push the centre button to put it down. Your saved order and hidden items stay.
- The Web Server screen shows a QR code of its address while it runs, so a phone camera opens the file browser, which now also shows the microSD card.
- Lyrics stored in MP3 tags are found also after a large cover and with more tag variants, and the same tag reader gives the year and the Play On album id.
- Add to Queue and Shuffle Play from an album's hold menu use the same track order as the album screen.

name: Classy 20261123 (beta)
body:
This is a beta release. To get it on the player, choose Settings > General > System Update > Update Channel > Beta.

- The Now Playing menu has a Queue row. It lists the coming tracks in play order (also with Shuffle), 100 at a time, with Earlier Tracks and Later Tracks rows to page. Push the centre button on a track to play it.
- Hold the centre button on an album for Shuffle Play, Add to Queue and Add to Playlist, without opening the album.
- Music > Moods browses the library by the MOOD tag of FLAC, Ogg and Opus files. Songs with no mood show under Unknown Mood.
- MP3 files now show their year also with ID3v2.4 tags, so Music > Years lists all years.
- With the screen off and Screen-Off Control on, holding Next or Previous seeks in the song; a short press still skips. The seek stops at the end of the song or at its start.
- The main menu is now a normal list, with the same highlight and smooth wheel steps as the other lists. The moving cover on its right uses about half as much CPU.
- The first start after the update scans the library once, to read the moods and the MP3 years.

name: Classy 20261122 (beta)
body:
This is a beta release. To get it on the player, choose Settings > General > System Update > Update Channel > Beta.

- On the Y2, the wheel now scrolls from its touch pads. Settings > Controls > Wheel Mode chooses Classic (the old steps, 9 rows a turn), Smooth (10 rows a turn) or Quick (15 rows a turn), and the letter jump starts from the real wheel speed.
- Lists can glide: at each wheel step the highlight moves to the new row and the rows scroll smoothly. It is on by default; Settings > Controls > List Glide turns it off. It is not on the Y1.
- Wheel steps in long lists take about a quarter less time, and album and song covers now load in the background, so the wheel does not wait for a cover.
- Cover Flow moves its cards with one motion model and loads the covers ahead of the scroll. Covers use less memory and each one loads once.
- Holding Back opens Now Playing from most screens (Settings > Controls > Hold Back for Now Playing, on by default).
- Settings > General > Power has Wi-Fi and Bluetooth switches and a Brightness row next to Restart and Power Off.
- A media button with the screen off (Screen-Off Control) no longer stops the music after an update on the Y2.
- Classic Light and Classic Dark are now built into the app. The old theme files and the `Y1_Themes` folder are deleted once after the update; the screens look the same.

name: Classy 20261116 (beta)
body:
This is a beta release. To get it on the player, choose Settings > General > System Update > Update Channel > Beta.

- All music now plays through ExoPlayer, also FLAC files. FLAC above 48 kHz plays too (24-bit 96 kHz in real time), and Speed, Software EQ and Crossfeed now change FLAC tracks.
- FLAC albums of 15 songs or fewer play gapless, as MP3 albums do.
- A song that cannot play shows a notice and is skipped. When no song of the queue plays, playback stops after one pass with "All tracks failed. Playback stopped." With Repeat Off, a broken last song stops playback at the end of the queue.
- At the end of a gapless album with Repeat Off, the player now waits at the first song (before, it went on to the second).
- Music Quiz uses one player for all clips and also asks about Opus and Ogg songs. A volume change during a clip now changes the sound.
- FM radio and the music of the games are not changed.

name: Y1 experimental 2 (20261112-exp.2-y1)
body:
Experimental build for the Innioasis Y1 (Android 4.2), to collect test results for #82. Only y1-exp.1 has a test on one Y1 Type A. Type B has no test. Do not use it on a Y2.

- `classy-y1-exp.2-type-a.zip` (Type A) or `classy-y1-exp.2-type-b.zip` (Type B): keep the file name. Do not rename it to `rom.zip`. In Innioasis Updater CE, select **Y1**, click **Install from a file…** > **Browse Files…**, select the zip, and click **Install / Restore**. If you installed a firmware file before, first click **Settings** > **Clear Firmware Cache**.
- After the first boot, `/system/app/com.themoon.y1.apk` must be 25,237,181 bytes. If it has a different size, the Updater installed an earlier firmware.
- `y1-logs.sh` (macOS, Linux) or `y1-logs.bat` (Windows): collect the logs and the clock data with adb into one zip file per boot.
- Do not use *Settings → System Update* on this build. Do not select *Classy* in the Updater CE list for the Y1: that is the official release, which needs Android 4.4.
- To go back: flash the stock Y1 firmware with the Updater.
- Changes since y1-exp.1: #83 (wheel keylayout, Cut-mode scrolling, library load at boot), `main` of 2026-11-12 (#84, #88, #89, #90, #91), album thumbnails at background priority. Branch `exp/y1-sdk17`. Instructions: #82.

name: Classy 20261113 (beta)
body:
This is a beta release. To get it on the player, choose Settings > General > System Update > Update Channel > Beta.

- Repeat All plays the whole list again, not only the current song.
- The screen stays on during a video, and the scrub bar shows the correct length.
- Choosing a podcast episode plays or opens that episode. When a feed does not load, the downloaded episodes of that channel still show.

name: InniClassic 20261104
body:
Thanks @ferrolho for making this release possible!

many bug fixes

- The volume curve uses thirty equal 2 dB steps (-58 dB to 0 dB) saved independently for each output, and volume buttons step once when clicked with the screen off. Wheel clicks have a dedicated Click Volume setting (Low, Medium, High), equalizer and audio effects run only when custom values are active, and graphic equalizer adjustments apply immediately while editing.
- Only one audio source plays at a time: starting a track pauses the FM radio, opening a video pauses playback, and starting USB Mass Storage stops the radio. The FM radio remains controllable with media buttons from any screen while active or paused.
- Long-pressing the center button opens an in-place track menu for playlist actions and album browsing. A single center press toggles a full-width lyrics overlay with edge fades, and a new Lyrics Keep Screen On setting prevents the display from sleeping during playback while lyrics are visible. Holding Play/Pause stops playback and rewinds to the beginning, while holding Next or Previous seeks up to 120x speed.
- The audio spectrum visualizer draws in the dominant album artwork color, stays visible at low volume levels, and stops its capture thread whenever the screen turns off or another screen is shown. Track times format in the classic style (`2:08`, `-0:34`, `1:02:08`), with a Total Time toggle to display total track length in place of remaining time.
- Physical button presses now register on release instead of initial push down, preventing duplicate inputs and ensuring held actions trigger cleanly. Hardware and Bluetooth remote controls continue to handle playback when the screen is dark, the on-screen keyboard standardizes on the QWERTY layout, and wheel scrolling loops consistently across Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, Music Quiz, and playlist screens.
- Cellular modem services stay permanently disabled on the Y2 to conserve battery. Bluetooth pairing accepts numeric comparison requests without requiring a touch screen, a Discoverable toggle makes the player visible to cars and external devices for two minutes, and track metadata transmits over AVRCP to in-vehicle displays. Music automatically pauses on Bluetooth disconnect or headphone removal and resumes if reconnected within four hours.
- Media scans compare file modification timestamps and sizes, re-reading only altered tracks and speeding up subsequent library rescans. Folder browsing defaults to secondary storage (`/storage/sdcard1/Music`), supports upward navigation (`..`), and lets you switch between storage volumes. Multi-genre tags are cataloged individually across FLAC, Opus, Ogg Vorbis, and ALAC files.
- Music menus include new options for Compilations, Shuffle Songs, and Group Albums (by Title or Title and Artist). iPod-style smart playlists for Recently Played and Top 25 Most Played tracks replace the legacy album history tracker.
- Cover Flow sorts albums by artist and then title, positions the artist name below the album cover, and jumps letter by letter during rapid wheel rotation. Fast wheel turns in song and album lists also jump alphabetically.
- Classic themes use the iPod Classic split-screen layout with slow cover motion, menu drop shadows, and matching zoom transitions. A low-battery warning banner appears at 10% battery with a "Please charge" screen at 2%. In the Y2 ROM, Android's stock battery dialog and low-power audio alert are disabled.
- A long press on the power button opens a dedicated iPod-style Power screen with Restart and Power Off options. Destructive actions like Reset Settings, Clear Album Art, Last.fm Log Out, and Settings Import now confirm on dedicated action screens where Back cancels.
- Settings are arranged into iPod-style categories with options to export and import settings backups, show On/Off toggles as switches (`Toggle Style`), and fade the top and bottom edges of long lists (`List Edges`). Themes can be switched without restarting the launcher, including an Auto theme that tracks local sunrise and sunset.
- Connecting storage switches the USB gadget mode to `mass_storage` before sharing partitions so partitions mount cleanly on host systems. The USB device name advertises Innioasis with the model number rather than generic MediaTek defaults, release builds stop on APIs newer than KitKat (API 19), and continuous integration checks verify 100% translation coverage across all seven languages.

name: InniClassic 20261017
body:
The Biggest Release!

- The entire application codebase has been rewritten from Java to 100% Kotlin, decomposing the monolithic main activity into dedicated domain managers, screen controllers, and an input router, backed by 16 regression test suites running in CI.
- Audiobooks is now a dedicated top-level section on the main menu, with hierarchical Jellyfin sync (Author -> Book -> Chapter), cover art downloads, continuous bookmark persistence across reboots, full chapter playlist resume, and a unified split-screen layout.
- The Videos section now provides a hierarchical browser for Movies, TV Series (with seasons and episodes), and raw directories, split-screen poster previews, Jellyfin video and thumbnail sync, and an automatic directory migration for existing files.
- Music Quiz transitions to an endless survival mode with six questions per round, speed scaling down to five seconds, a between-round pause screen with a heart shop, a persistent top 10 leaderboard, and tiered year question distractors.
- A new Recently Played Albums menu item beneath Cover Flow tracks up to 50 recently played albums with cover art, track counts, track-number-ordered browsing, and an option to clear playback history.
- Device shutdown now saves the active queue and playback position, automatically restoring the player in a paused state at the exact track and timestamp after rebooting.
- Playback cleanly pauses and rewinds to the first track when finishing an album with repeat turned off, while the library scanner now skips files smaller than 1KB and logs corrupt audio files.
- Back navigation now preserves selected row focus and scroll position across the main menu, settings, playlists, and browser lists instead of resetting to the top item.
- Split-screen pages in Music, Videos, and Audiobooks now share a unified 242dp status bar width matching the left navigation pane, while video browsing fixes eliminate poster clipping, top gaps, and double padding.
- Now Playing album art now reliably updates on the main menu and music split panes during playback.
- The theme catalog has been streamlined to Classic Light and Classic Dark, automatically cleaning up leftover assets from legacy themes during startup.
- Physical buttons and wheel haptic feedback are now completely muted while the screen is off when Screen-Off Control is disabled, and the idle backlight sleep timer now stays synchronized with system settings.

  - Turning Bluetooth off now stays off across reboots instead of turning itself back on at startup.
  - "Delete Device" now verifies that unpairing succeeded before showing a confirmation message and refreshes the paired list cleanly.

- Genre browsing now follows the classic iPod hierarchy (`Genre -> Artists / All Songs -> Albums / All Songs -> Songs`), and song lists have a Shuffle banner with a song counter at the top. Returning from Now Playing also highlights the playing track, fast scrolling no longer crashes on lists with header rows, and the wheel no longer gets stuck at list edges.

body:

- Custom themes no longer reset to the default theme after unplugging from USB Mass Storage because the selected theme is now saved by name instead of folder scan order. Newly created `.scrobbler.log` files also declare `#TZ/UTC` so scrobble importers read their timestamps as UTC.

name: InniClassic 20260927
body:
First release with support for the Innioasis Y2 alongside the Innioasis Y1 (Type A and Type B).

- Music, audiobooks, and videos are now indexed across both internal storage (`/storage/sdcard0`) and the removable microSD card (`/storage/sdcard1`).
- A background SD card monitor watches for unexpected microSD disconnects, such as after unplugging from USB, and remounts the card automatically before refreshing your library. This also fixes a crash loop during media indexing and stops the monitor from touching internal storage.
- The Y2 capacitive click wheel (`mtk-tpd-kpd`) is mapped to standard left and right scroll navigation across all menus and lists.
- FM radio now works on the Y2. Opening the radio sets tuner device permissions, stops background stock radio apps that would otherwise lock `/dev/fm`, and keeps Airplane Mode from blocking the tuner.
- Automated builds produce flashable ROM packages for the Y2, Y1 Type A, and Y1 Type B, along with a standalone APK.

| `SHA256SUMS.txt` | All files | SHA-256 integrity checksums |
